description: This file is a shell script used for testing git commit porcelain-like behavior, including commit message formatting, trailers, cleanup modes, and interaction with editors. It contains test cases for verifying git commit functionalities and behaviors.

methods.name: commit_msg_is
methods.description: Compares the latest git log message against an expected message for verification.

methods.name: check_summary_oneline
methods.description: Checks the output of a git commit summary against an expected format.

methods.name: trailer_commit_base
methods.description: Creates a commit with trailers for testing the --trailer option.

methods.name: output_tests_cleanup
methods.description: Resets the git repository to a clean state after certain tests.

methods.name: try_commit
methods.description: Performs a git commit with optional arguments and verifies the presence of a template header.

methods.name: try_commit_status_combo
methods.description: Runs a series of commit tests with different options to verify statuses and configurations.
